summary: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution to cancel up to 6,698,565 common shares (including one fractional share) with an estimated cancellation amount of KRW 700 billion (~$542M). The shares will be acquired via open-market purchases on the Korea Exchange (KRX) from July 31 to October 22, 2026, at prices determined by market conditions; the per-share price is based on the July 22, 2026 closing price of KRW 104,500. This cancellation reduces issued shares but not total capital, and is conducted under Korean Commercial Code Article 343. A previously held treasury share from a share exchange is also included. The company will file a final 6-K/A before cancellation. Watch for actual buyback price variations and timing of the final cancellation.
